title: Bouclé sofa in the winter room

tokens.v: EXTREME MACRO — the frame filled by four centimetres of looped ivory wool. Disregard every 50mm, eye-level, whole-piece, true-scale and full-room framing instruction in this brief. 100mm macro at f/4, framed 1:1 life-size, camera an inch above the cushion, tilted along the seat seam. Snow has blown in through the open pane and settled into the pile: two crystals still hold their six arms, a third has collapsed to a dark damp coin where the wool drank it. The plinth chamfer runs soft across the bottom edge, cut left and right.
